source.version: Part 17 — Integrated Pest Management, Biosecurity, and Sanitation — Batch 04
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-09-01. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-336–340 close Volume 17 with evidence-bounded biological controls, current 2026 pesticide label/legal and resistance-management guidance, isolation/removal/waste handling, corrective and preventive action, and IPM program audit/continuous improvement. Public wording separates research efficacy from commercial/legal authorization; in vitro from in planta efficacy; isolation from diagnosis; contributing factors from proven causation; task completion from effectiveness verification; and audit metrics from a zero-pest guarantee.
source.note: This batch closes controlled Volume 17 at THC-ENC-340 and completes the IPM sequence from prevention and monitoring through lawful integrated control, containment, CAPA, and program audit.
